description: This file defines the AttendeeService class which implements business logic for managing attendees within an event management API. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting attendees, interacting with repository classes and handling validation such as event existence check.

classes.name: AttendeeService
classes.description: Service layer for business logic related to attendees, providing methods to create, retrieve, list, update, and delete attendee records, interacting with repositories and validating data.

methods.name: Attendee create_attendee(self, *, event_id: int, name: str, email: str)
methods.description: Creates a new attendee for a specific event after verifying the event exists.

methods.name: Optional[Attendee] get_attendee(self, attendee_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an attendee by their ID.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Attendee],int] list_attendees(self, event_id: Optional[int] = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100, search: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Lists attendees with optional filtering by event ID, search string, and supports pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Attendee] update_attendee(self, attendee_id: int, data: dict)
methods.description: Updates an attendee record with partial data.

methods.name: bool delete_attendee(self, attendee_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an attendee record by ID.
